label: PF Backlog 92
title: Backend: reusable dashboard+API blueprint - instantiated for Product Forge AND every pipeline-created project
body: Owner: build ONE reusable control-plane blueprint (dashboard + API) and instantiate it for (a) Product Forge itself and (b) EVERY project the pipeline creates - so each delivered product ships with its own dashboard+API (auth, SSE, backlog, git page, tests, licensing, etc.). Shared code from the blueprint/template; DATA scoped per instance (each project's own stores). INSTANCE_ROLE + build-time operator/tenant split still apply. Generalizes BI-0016 (tests for every created project) to the whole control-plane surface. The pipeline PROVISIONS a project's dashboard/API as part of that project's deliverables.
_note: done: core/dashboard_blueprint.py + config/dashboard-blueprint.json + instantiate at stages + GET /api/v1/blueprint
